summary: Iteration 149 - Testing Mobility Frequent Routes, XP-Claims, VIP-Perk-Aktivierungen. All 19 backend tests pass. Frontend UI verified: Mobility Center shows Frequent Routes section with One-Tap Rebook buttons, Game Center shows XP-Claim buttons for Season Milestones (500/1500/3000 XP) and VIP Perk Aktivierungen (VIP Spin, XP Boost, Season Drop). StaffManagement/Admin pages load without regression.

issues: VIP Activation Grid only visible when user has active subscription - expected behavior but could show disabled state for non-VIP users

vip_page.notes: VIP Activation Grid only visible with active subscription

staff_management_page.notes: Shows upgrade screen when no subscription active - expected behavior, no regression

admin_page.notes: Admin grid menu loads correctly with all sections

mobility_frequent_routes_display.details: Mobility Center shows Frequent Routes section with 'Best Route Flow' heading, route cards with usage count, avg price, and One-Tap Rebook buttons

frequent_route_save_api.details: POST /api/mobility-platform/frequent-routes saves new Frequent Route with label, pickup, dropoff, transport_type, payment_method

best_route_book_api.details: POST /api/mobility-platform/best-route-book books a saved Frequent Route with route_id, transport_type, payment_method

game_center_xp_claims.details: Game Center shows Season Milestones (500 XP, 1500 XP, 3000 XP) with 'XP claimen' buttons. POST /api/gaming/season-claim endpoint works

vip_perk_activations_game_center.details: Game Center shows VIP Perk Aktivierungen panel with VIP Spin, XP Boost, Season Drop cards and 'Perk aktivieren' buttons

vip_perk_activations_vip_page.details: VIP page shows subscription plans. VIP Activation Grid visible only when user has active subscription

staff_admin_no_regression.details: StaffManagement and Admin pages load without JavaScript errors. ESLint warning fixes did not cause regression

critical_code_review_comments: ESLint warnings in GamingPage.jsx, StaffManagementPage.jsx, VipPage.jsx, AdminPage.jsx are unused imports/variables - cosmetic only, no functional impact
seed_data_creation: Created test frequent routes during backend testing
